rules.rule: Rinse containers to remove food residue before recycling.
rules.impact: Reduces batch contamination by up to 40%.

rules.rule: Keep cardboard and paper clean and dry. Flatten boxes.
Remove plastic or metal caps from glass bottles.
rules.impact: Prevents furnace contamination during glass melting.
Saves 95% of energy required to manufacture virgin metal.

rules.rule: Do not throw electronic devices in regular trash bins.
rules.impact: Recovers rare earth metals and avoids toxic chemical leaks.

rules.rule: Never pour chemicals, paints, or solvents into household drains.
rules.impact: Protects municipal wastewater and groundwater resources.
